paragraphs: Art. 1. For certifying that copies and extracts of documents and papers kept in the registry office are true, a fee of 3 лв. for the first page and 2 лв. for each further page is charged. When the request is made electronically, the fee is 5 лв.

Art. 2. (1) For the entry of acts and documents that are subject to entry, a fee of 0.1 per cent is charged on the price on which the act or the document was charged, or on the value of the claim, but not less than 10 лв. When the price on which the document was charged is not stated, the fee is set on an assessment made under Appendix No. 2 to the Local Taxes and Fees Act.
(2) For the entry of a certificate of a change in the legal form of a commercial company, and of an application to set aside court decisions subject to entry, a fee of 10 лв. is charged.
Art. 3. (1) For a note (including the acts under Art. 17 of the Regulations on Entries), a deletion or a renewal of an entry, half of the fee charged for the entry is charged.

(2) When the note, the deletion or the renewal is requested for part of the claim secured by a mortgage, or only for some of the properties, half of the fee under Art. 2 is charged, calculated on the amount for which the note, the deletion or the renewal is requested, or, if the request states no amount, on the amount of the first entry.

(3) When the deletion of the entry of a mortgage is requested by the buyer at a public sale under Art. 19(2) of the Regulations on Entries, by an interested person under Art. 22 of the Regulations on Entries, or on the basis of a court decision, a fee of 10 лв. is due.
Art. 4. (1) For the entry of a certificate of a special pledge entered in the Commercial Register over a commercial enterprise whose assets include real estate, a fee of 80 лв. is charged.

(2) For notes and deletions (additional circumstances within the meaning of the Special Pledges Act) and for the renewal of an entry on the basis of a certificate issued by the Commercial Register, half of the fee under para. 1 is charged.
Art. 5. For the entry of a waiver of real rights in real estate and for the entry of a prohibition (attachment), a fee of 15 лв. is charged.

Art. 6. (1) For an oral inquiry in a personal partida, given in the registry office, a fee of 2 лв. is charged. When a paper copy of the records in the information system, a copy of a document or an extract of a document is given with the oral inquiry, an additional fee of 1 лв. for the first page and 0.10 лв. for each further page is charged.
(2) For an inquiry by remote access to the information system, a fee of 1 лв. for each inquiry is charged.
(3) When a copy of a document is given by remote access to the information system, a fee of 2.50 лв. is charged.
Art. 7. (1) For a certificate under Art. 46 of the Regulations on Entries of the entries, notes and deletions made for a specific person, the following fees are charged:
1. issue within 7 working days – 5 лв.;
2. issue within 3 working days – 10 лв.;
3. issue within 8 working hours – 25 лв.
(2) For a certificate under Art. 47 of the Regulations on Entries of the entries, notes and deletions made for one property, the following fees are charged:
1. issue within 7 working days – 10 лв.;
2. issue within 3 working days – 30 лв.
(3) When the terms under paras. 1 and 2 are not kept, the fee under para. 1 is 5 лв. and the fee under para. 2 is 10 лв.

(4) When one application asks for a certificate under Art. 46 of the Regulations on Entries for more than one person, a separate certificate is issued for each person, and the fee under para. 1 is charged for each.

(5) When one application asks for a certificate under Art. 47 of the Regulations on Entries for more than one property, a separate certificate is issued for each property, and the fee under para. 2 is charged for each.
(6) (Repealed.)

Art. 7а. When the state fee is paid electronically, a certified copy of the electronic document, reproduced on paper as a copy certified by a party to the act, by a notary or by the bank that received or made the payment, is presented to the registry office.
